run_train_loop: run the TrainLoop class to train a diffusion model with distributed data parallel and EMA tracking
resume_checkpoint_training: resume training from the latest checkpoint by calling find_resume_checkpoint and loading saved model parameters
save_model_checkpoint: save the model and optimizer state to a checkpoint file using the TrainLoop save method
find_ema_checkpoint: find an EMA checkpoint file by step number and rate using the find_ema_checkpoint function
log_loss_dict: log diffusion training losses with quartile breakdown using the log_loss_dict function
